archive.deleted_artifact_scope: Both experimental output directories, input/query caches, source snapshots, models, renders, logs and dedicated alternative implementation/test scripts.
archive.historical_hash_note: Protocol/source/model hashes identify completed historical experiments; they do not assert current source equality or retained experimental files.

rerun_history.invalid_first_run_reason: Quantized skinny triangle barycentric clipping was numerically unstable; replace with closest 3D point and matching barycentrics for UV and geometry audit.

interruption.reason: Turn interruption stopped the final four processes before final model/optimizer checkpoints were saved.

benchmark_limitations: Shared/concurrent GPU load; this was not a same-GPU same-load speed benchmark.
A recorded complete shared projection/resampling/reinitialization plans; B/C/D replayed them.
D standalone pipeline time was not measured; historical D depended on a complete A run.
Original best timing and rerun timings are historical observations, not directly comparable speed rankings.

baseline_reproduction.comparison: Corrected rerun A against retained models; four-group causal comparisons use the corrected A, not the retained models.
baseline_reproduction.reproduction: Matching input caches do not imply identical trained models. Causes of rerun differences were not isolated.
